top_signals.title: BOJ keeps rates unchanged amid speculation of yen intervention
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Japan's decision to sit tight was widely expected as the central bank just raised its policy rate from 0.75% to 1% in June.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Strategy posts $8.2B Q2 loss as Bitcoin slump drives unrealized losses
top_signals.summary: The Bitcoin treasury company said it has built a $3.75 billion cash reserve to support preferred stock payouts following the launch of its BTC monetization program.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Post Biggest Gain in Four Months on AI Optimism
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks posted their biggest gain in nearly four months as investors piled into chipmakers, after blockbuster earnings from major tech firms reinforced optimism over AI demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Samsung and SK Hynix answer AI doubters with big numbers and deals
top_signals.summary: Market participants want answers to a far bigger question than last quarter's profitability: Is the pace of AI infrastructure spending sustainable?
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
